title: Invoice data entry is eating our Fridays
text: We're a 12-person bookkeeping firm. Every Friday we still do this manually: we re-key vendor invoices from PDFs into QuickBooks. Our admin spends hours every week on it, and we pay a VA $15/hr to help at month-end. Errors cost us a $400 late fee last quarter.

title: Feature request: import vendor invoices from emailed PDFs
text: Our accounts payable team spends hours every week copying invoice lines from PDF attachments into the ledger by hand. ExampleBooks doesn't support PDF invoice import, so we re-key vendor invoices from PDFs ourselves.

title: Why small practices still type invoices
text: Small accounting practices still re-key vendor invoices from PDFs by hand, and one owner said the data entry takes hours every month.

title: AP clerk drowning in PDFs
text: I run AP for a property management company and we re-key vendor invoices from PDFs into our accounting system every day. We hired a part-time clerk at $22/hour just for invoice data entry.

title: Move-out inspections are a nightmare
text: We manage 300 units. Move-out inspections are a nightmare: we take photos on phones, then copy and paste them into a Word report and an Excel spreadsheet to work out deposit deductions. It happens every week during peak season. Last year we lost $1,850 in small claims because our inspection photos weren't dated.

title: Move-out inspection reports
text: Is there a tool that handles move-out inspection reports for small property managers? We track move-out inspection photos in Google Sheets and it is a mess every month.

title: Rate cons
text: As a small freight brokerage we re-key rate confirmations from carrier emails into our TMS by hand, every day, and it slows down carrier payments.
